images.summary: SignalDeck's first released module firmware for the Armor 26 Ultra. It adds a transmitter that sends M17 voice and text, POCSAG pages, FT8, RTTY and Morse straight from the module, and keeps plain FM, CTCSS, SSTV and DMR as the phone shipped. Needs SignalDeck beta.22 or newer.
changes: Command 0x40 (new): M17 symbol transmitter, generic symbol and tone engines (POCSAG, FT8, RTTY, Morse), receive-filter hold for M17 and page receive, flash read-back, promiscuous DMR receive flag (off at every boot).
Key path: plain FM, CTCSS, SSTV and DMR keys run the stock key; only a queued symbol or tone transmission takes the module transmitter.
Transmit time-out: unchanged from stock. The module stores the value the app sends (SignalDeck sends 120 s at start-up); no time-out is added in firmware (owner rule 2026-10-28).
No band-limit, frequency-range or power changes.

images.summary: The firmware this phone shipped with. Loading it puts the module back the way it was. The image stays until another one is loaded, including across a reboot.

The module firmware file an Atom XL keeps on its vendor partition for the stock app's updater. It is an older build than the V082 the phone's module reports, so it is kept for research and is not offered as a restore image.

variants.notes: The module was powered off during the report's probe, so no version string yet. Same stock-app family as the Armor 26 Ultra.
The reference phone. The stock app sends a time-out byte of 0 at start, which turns the module's own 120 s timer off.
Different module build from the Armor's; its stock image has not been extracted, so no base and no patches yet.

The updater copy on the vendor partition (/vendor/data/DMR/dmr/), not what the module runs (V082 on the reporting owner's phone, V067 on the bench phone). Image in firmware/unihertz-atom-xl/DMR006.U4A.V076/; no base, no patches.

The bench phone's module (0x34 reply through the bridge, 2026-10-28). The image is not on the phone (vendor partition, data, every partition but userdata searched read only; only V076 is there) and not in the stock APK, so no base and no patches.
